family5990.lower_bound_reason: On the cube product, each n-row density is >=(1/72)^n and its volume is (1/8)^n. Average two-model error is >=half their density overlap; worst-model error is at least that average.
family5990.noise_law: Independent standard centered Gaussian U0,U1,U2, independently repeated for each observed row; an ideal mathematical sampling model, not a PRNG-independence certificate.

overlap.exponential_proof: e = sum_k 1/k! <3 using the geometric upper bound on the factorial tail; q<=1 implies exp(-q)>=1/3.

family5990.population: The two covariance laws differ and their faithful one-edge skeletons give distinct Gaussian Markov equivalence classes. Population class identification is possible within this specified family.
family5990.universal_zero_error_recovery: refuted for every possibly randomized estimator required to return the single correct Markov equivalence class from finitely many observational rows
